name: crmc_uran_fuel_can
description: Uranium fuel can: 5px URAN column in a 1px CRMC (ceramic) sleeve, INSL wrap, TTAN outer wall, with PCLN(LN2)+CLNE(LN2) emergency-cryo pads on the shoulders. One column of the 6-rod Auto Mode reactor.
why: Save 1289009 (Uranium Power Plant v1.0): six identical cans at 24px pitch, URAN (134 per can) in CRMC at (51-57,269-298), INSL then TTAN outside; LN2 pads at (46-47,265-266) with CLNE(LN2) so an emergency dump refills itself; TSNS ladder beside each can reads 50..1200C in 10 steps. CRMC is used because it does not conduct and survives the fuel temperature.
